title: Lucky Daye & Yung Miami to Headline Billboard’s R&B Hip-Hop Live 2026 Concert
summary: Samara Cyn, Skippa & Destin Conrad will also take the stage in Brooklyn.
contentText:
Billboard revealed Thursday (Aug. 13) that Lucky Daye and Yung Miami will headline its R&B Hip-Hop Live 2026 concert, which serves as the centerpiece of the company’s R&B Hip-Hop Week.

In addition to Daye and the “Spend Dat” rapper, the lineup will be rounded out by rising stars such as Samara Cyn, Skippa and Destin Conrad.

“ Billboard has always been at the epicenter of music and culture,” said Mike Van, CEO of Billboard . “As hip-hop, R&B and Caribbean music continue to shape culture around the world, we’re committed to championing the emerging voices, generational artists and passionate fans driving these genres forward.” 

Tickets are slated to begin going on sale starting Thursday at noon ET. Those planning to attend the concert who are Amazon Music app users will be able to utilize the Fast Entry Lane for quicker access into the Brooklyn venue.

Lucky Daye returned with his first single of the year in June, as the R&B singer’s “Nowhere Fast” hit streaming services. Yung Miami struck gold with her catchy “Spend Dat” anthem , which reached the Billboard Hot 100’s top 20 (No. 17 peak) this summer.

It’s been a busy year for the up-and-comers as well: Samara Cyn showcased her rapping dexterity on her Detour EP, Destin Conrad’s ROADRUNNER album is set to arrive on Aug. 21, and Skippa continued his ascension with his #Skippaholic project.
